title: Palindrome, Special Words & Symmetry Test Paper (ICSE Class X)
prerequisites: ICSE Class X String handling methods, Scanner input, conditional branching, and loops
instructions: All questions are compulsory as per ICSE examination standards.
Write complete Java code for Section B problems including Variable Description Tables.
Pay strict attention to case sensitivity, loop bounds, and array indexing.
Each question carries marks as indicated.

sections.description: Answer in one or two sentences or evaluate the code output.

questions.q: In ICSE Board examination terminology, what is the exact difference between a Palindrome Word and a Special Word?
questions.answer: A **Palindrome Word** reads identically forwards and backwards (e.g., "MADAM", "RADAR"). A **Special Word** starts and ends with the exact same letter (e.g., "EXIST", "WINDOW", "MADAM"). All palindromes with length >= 1 are special words, but not all special words are palindromes.
questions.hint: Check both the reverse condition and the first/last character condition.

questions.q: Why does the condition `if (str == rev)` fail to evaluate to true in Java even when 'str' and 'rev' contain identical characters?
questions.answer: The `==` operator compares memory addresses (object references) on the Heap, not string content. Because `rev` is dynamically constructed at runtime, it occupies a distinct Heap memory address. `.equals()` or `.equalsIgnoreCase()` must be used.

questions.q: What is the output of `"CIVIC".equalsIgnoreCase(new String("civic"))`?
questions.answer:
Output: `true`
Explanation: equalsIgnoreCase compares textual contents ignoring uppercase/lowercase differences.

questions.q: Write a loop snippet to reverse a string 'w' into 'rev' without using StringBuffer.
questions.hint: Prepend the extracted character to rev.

questions.q: Write the boolean expression to check if string 's' has length >= 1 and starts and ends with the same character.

sections.description: Write complete Java programs with class declaration, main method, and Variable Description Table.

questions.q:
Write a program to accept a word. Check and display whether it is:
(i) A PALINDROME and SPECIAL WORD
(ii) A SPECIAL WORD but not a PALINDROME
(iii) NEITHER a PALINDROME nor a SPECIAL WORD
Include a Variable Description Table.
questions.hint: Compute reversed string, test word.equals(rev), and test charAt(0) == charAt(length-1).

questions.q: Write a program to accept a sentence. Extract each word and display only the palindrome words present in the sentence.
questions.hint: Extract each word, reverse it with an inner loop, and compare with equalsIgnoreCase.
